description: Cursor-style agent chat pane for Lens
view.title: Chat
config.title: Lens Chat
config.attachOpenFile: Offer the active file as context in Lens Chat when nothing is selected. A selection is always offered. Secret and key files, and files matched by files.exclude, search.exclude or .gitignore, are never offered.
config.autoCompactThreshold: Compact a chat automatically after a reply once its context window is this full (percent, 1-100). `0` turns this off; the engine still compacts a chat when its context is completely full. Type `/compact` in Lens Chat to compact at any time.
